limitations: Architectural retrofit study, not construction certification or verified energy performance.
Existing main mass and arched opening envelopes retained; glazing divisions, frame details and applied assemblies change.
Rigid BIPV fascia modules are separate flat rectangles, not panels bent to the canopy curve.
PV orientation, structure, ventilation and drainage require technical coordination.
Source units preserved; physical scale requires confirmation.
Desktop Autodesk AutoCAD unavailable; independent DWG roundtrip passed with source-coordinate and circular-curve comparison.

analytic_endpoint_check.method: Test native line endpoints against other straight paths and analytic circular arcs, including connections to edge interiors.
